result.summary: The page is generally polished, but there are a couple of visible content and layout issues.

issues.description: The “Fastest near you” carousel shows the same Green Bowl Poké restaurant twice with identical imagery, title, delivery time, and price, which looks like duplicated content.
issues.suggestion: Replace one duplicate card with a different nearby restaurant or remove the duplicate listing.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation overlaps the lower restaurant card, leaving its content visibly cut off at the bottom of the viewport.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding to the scrollable content so cards can be viewed completely above the navigation bar.

issues.description: The category chips and restaurant cards are visibly clipped at the right edge, and the partial next item provides no clear indication that the rows are horizontally scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle scroll cue, peek spacing, or carousel affordance while preserving the horizontal layout.
